title: Apply for a registered relationship certificate
summary: Learn how to request a registered or revoked relationship certificate if your relationship is or was on the NSW Relationships Register.
intro:
The NSW Relationships Register provides legal recognition for de facto couples.

If your relationship is on the Register, or was previously on the Register, you're able to request a registered relationship certificate or revoked relationship certificate.

You can do this in person at a service centre, or by mail.
who_can_apply: Your relationship must be or have been registered on the NSW Relationship Register.
You must be one of the people listed on the register as being or having been in the relationship.
what_you_need: The reason you need the certificate
Three personal identity documents specified on the form

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and lodge your application in person, or post the information to:

more_info.text: Certificates are sent by the Registry of Births, Deaths & Marriages via registered post. They cannot be collected at a service centre.
Processing times commence when applications are received in full compliance with Registry requirements, and exclude delivery time.
If you change your mind, or decide the certificate is no longer required, your application fee will not be refunded.
We suggest you do not laminate your certificates. Where possible, identity documents should be kept in their original state.

faqs.q: Who can apply for a registered relationship certificate?
faqs.a: You must be one of the people listed on the NSW Relationship Register, or have been in the relationship.

faqs.q: How can I submit my application?
faqs.a: You can apply in person at a service centre or by mail.
